status: FROZEN_BEFORE_FIRST REAL GRAPH NUMERIC WEIGHT WRITE
purpose: Largest-first encode ALL real structured TRAIN facts in a fixed endianness no-gradient numerical memory and cold restore, as an ENGINEERING capacity test. Not a learning/AGI/generalization claim.

max_stage.format: For each original train triple line in original source order, write little-endian UInt32 subject QID, property PID, object QID. This is known-fact direct weight programming, NOT a learned mapping.
max_stage.read_scope: Only train.txt after verifying archive SHA and exact train content; NEVER open validation/test graph records.
max_stage.cold: At approximately half the triples, snapshot the entire weight byte image, hash, release, restore exact bytes from ephemeral source-independent temporary cold file, verify hash, then append remaining triples and seal final weights.
max_stage.fallback_policy: Only after failing original full-tier resource/time bound; source-row hash selection must be declared in a separate pre-first-use commit, never take easiest rows after results

measurements: actual source row count, property breadth, source train SHA, exact numeric slot count 3 per triple, cold snapshot digest, full packed digest, measured CPU/wall and numeric resident byte size, source bytes, first-use audit; no model accuracy or heldout scoring.
strong_baseline: Exact graph retrieval from stored triples has equal source information and may be faster; no scientific superiority claim without matched query indexing, reasoning, model updates and heldout generalization.
no_shortcut: Four-rule synthetic test from WSP101 was easier than real graph; 21.34m known triple direct storage is memorization, not causal transfer, new rule discovery, general reasoning or AGI.
criteria: Engineering PASS only if all 21,343,681 train rows pack, byte count=256,124,172, cold-restored first half unchanged, source SHA remains identical and no original/heldout use. Otherwise engineering NEGATIVE; preserve failure.
